# Operations Service Standard: Customer Wait Time and Branch Efficiency

This document outlines critical operational directives:

*   Monitor customer wait time urgently.
*   Review branch efficiency for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize branch efficiency based on audit findings.
*   Review customer wait time urgently.
*   Review customer wait time quarterly.
